faqs.question: How to get Poland work visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Your Polish employer obtains the correct permit/declaration; you apply for the national visa with a complete file. SK prepares your side.

faqs.question: Do I need Polish language?
faqs.answer: Helpful on factory floors and services; some workplaces use English supervisors. Case by case.

faqs.question: Is Poland work easier than Western Europe?
faqs.answer: Employer demand can be strong, but document accuracy still decides outcomes. We do not call any country “easy.”

faqs.question: Can I take family?
faqs.answer: Family reunification has separate eligibility after you hold proper residence. Ask in consult.

faqs.question: Who is SK Immigration?
faqs.answer: SECP-registered immigration consultancy in Rawalpindi, OEP partner licence NO/1061, WhatsApp +92 304 5999859.

body:
Poland work permit / work visa from Pakistan

Poland has strong demand in manufacturing, logistics and services. Employer paperwork (zezwolenie / oświadczenie types) must match your visa category.

Requirements

  • Polish work permit or eligible employer declaration
  • Employment contract details
  • Passport, photos, forms
  • Qualifications and experience evidence
  • Insurance and accommodation as requested

Process

  1. Verify employer documents
  2. Build Pakistan-side checklist
  3. Translations / legalization if needed
  4. Visa appointment and biometrics
  5. Travel briefing

Documents

  • Passport, photos, visa form
  • Work permit / declaration originals or certified copies
  • CV and certificates
  • Civil docs if requested
  • Fee receipts

Related checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK from PKR 80,000. Consular fees separate.

Timeline

Often 1–4 months after employer papers are ready.

Common mistakes

  • Mismatched permit type vs visa category
  • Unverified Polish “agents” selling fake permits
  • Expired medicals
  • Weak travel history explanations when asked

Work route reality check for Poland

Work permits and declarations have specific employer steps before visa filing.

SK Immigration helps with CV packaging, document checklists and appointment prep. We do not sell fake job guarantees. Employers and missions decide.

Before you pay anyone

  • Confirm the job/contract type matches the visa subclass
  • Language level matches employer expectations
  • Educational documents follow the correct attestation chain
  • You understand SK fees vs medical/government fees
